title: Boston + Big E 2026
summary: A recap site for a weekend trip to Boston and the Big E fair: the route, the stops and the photos, in one scrollable page.
notes: I describe the trip, drop in the stops and photos, and have AI generate the page. Deployed as a Cloudflare Worker so each trip gets its own link.

title: Ashar Travel
summary: My travel site, with a running map and list of every country I've visited. Updated after each trip.
notes: After a trip I tell AI which countries to add, and it updates the data and redeploys. The October 2026 Eastern Europe trip added five countries in one pass.

title: Daily celebrations post
summary: Every morning, a Slack post lists the day's national and informal days, like National Pancake Day, so the team has something fun to start with.
notes: A scheduled Claude task looks up today's observances, picks the good ones, and posts a short formatted message to a Slack channel.

title: Food Finds
summary: A weekly digest of 15 new food spots, worldwide, around New York and Long Island, and near the office, each with a Google Maps link.
notes: Claude searches for newly opened places each week, filters out ones it has already sent, and delivers a short list with map links I can save in one tap.

title: NYC AI events digest
summary: A weekly email of free AI and tech events in New York, plus the social Luma and Partiful invites worth going to.
notes: Claude scans event listings, keeps the free and relevant ones, and emails me a digest sorted by date.

title: Slack to Calendar sync
summary: Turns event posts in a Slack channel into Google Calendar events, without duplicates, and updates them when the post changes.
notes: The tricky part was making it duplicate-safe and update-aware: each event keeps a link back to its Slack message, so a re-run edits the existing event instead of adding a second one.

title: This portfolio
summary: The page you're on. Every project is one entry in a JSON file, so adding something new takes a minute.
notes: Plain HTML, CSS and a little JavaScript, no build step. Claude designed and wrote it; I add projects by editing projects.json and pushing.
